contentNotes: the vocabulary note "ça + va (être)" names the wrong verb: "va" comes from aller, so the note should read "ça + va (aller)".
the gap-fill "Je ___ mes amis au café" with answer "attends" reads "Je attends"; French elides it to "J'attends".
the vocabulary entry and concept card "rendre + adjective" have the English placeholder "adjective" where a French example belongs (for example "rendre heureux").
the concept cards teach "plus bon que (better than)" and "c'est plus bon", which are wrong French; the comparative of bon is "meilleur" ("meilleur que", "c'est meilleur").
the concept cards teach "plus bon que" and "c'est plus bon", which are wrong French; the comparative of bon is "meilleur" ("meilleur que", "c'est meilleur").

the gap-fill "Je suis en retard ___ le traffic" with answer "à cause du" reads "à cause du le traffic" once filled; drop "le" from the prompt. "traffic" is the English spelling: French writes "trafic" (also in the à cause de concept card and a feedback line).
the gap-fill "Je ___ au café quand tu m'as appelé" with answer "allais" reads "Je allais"; French elides it to "J'allais".
the gap-fill "Elle ne ___ pas ___" with answer "est pas venue" reads "Elle ne est pas venue" once filled; French elides it to "Elle n'est pas venue".
the gap-fill "Pendant que je ___, on a parlé pendant une heure" with answer "étais" reads "je étais"; French elides it to "j'étais" (and "While I was there" needs "là": "Pendant que j'étais là").

the gap-fill "La lampe est ___ le lit" with answer "au-dessus du" reads "au-dessus du le lit" once filled; drop "le" from the prompt. "il-y-a" in the parmi exercises is written "il y a", without hyphens.

the gap-fill "Il est fatigué ___ du travail" with answer "à cause de" reads "à cause de du travail" once filled; French says "à cause du travail": make the answer "à cause du" and drop "du" from the prompt.
